result.summary: Identified two minor layout and content issues on the food delivery screen.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated abruptly as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipses.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis or dynamic font scaling to handle longer titles gracefully.

issues.description: The promo badge on the bottom pizza item displays a '-100%' discount, which appears to be placeholder or erroneous data.
issues.suggestion: Validate promotional data values before rendering to prevent misleading discount tags.
